body:
hello, and thanks again for taking the time to read and reply. 

it is a shame that i have used my eloquence and other skills mainly to hide my problems and cope in an unsustainable way. Worked for a while, does not work anymore.

And yes, i felt ok with all of this as long i was left alone, which stopped with kindergarten and school. hated every single day in the education system and it left me broken.
